prompt:
A pavement photographed from directly overhead, the camera pointing straight
down, vertical frame, graphic and clean. The picture is split in half down
the middle by the painted edge, which runs from the top of the frame to the
bottom. THE PHOTOGRAPHER IS STANDING ASTRIDE THAT PAINTED EDGE, one foot on
the red and one foot on the grey, holding the camera straight down over the
line: the edge therefore falls directly under the middle of the lens, and
the red and the grey each take one half of the picture. To the left of the
line, a bicycle strip painted a faded dusty brick red, muted and
desaturated, closer to weathered terracotta than to bright red, with one
white bicycle pictogram on it, close to the line. To the right of the line,
grey pavement slabs. Daylight, overcast and flat.
